episodes.title: Day 4: the fog sent us a nailed-shut crate. Something was inside
episodes.beat: Still nobody has moved in. A nailed-shut crate washes ashore with something scratching inside. For once Morten lets Bram have it; Bram pries off the lid and about forty very confused crabs walk out sideways in every direction. Bram decides he doesn't want it after all and goes back to the chair. The cat sits on the crate all night. The ship still has three planks.

episodes.title: Day 3: the fog sent us a rowboat with nobody in it
episodes.beat: Still nobody has moved in. The fog sends a rowboat with nobody in it, dry, oars stowed neatly as if someone meant to come back. The cat climbs in. Bram wants its boards for the ship and is told no again; he sulks in the chair. The ship still has three planks.

episodes.title: Day 2: we said hello to the fog, and it sent back a chair
episodes.beat: Nobody has moved in yet. The sea answers the Hello? bottle with a chair, just a chair, bone dry. Morten sets it facing the wall; Bram wants it for the ship and is told no. The ship still has three planks.

episodes.title: Day 1: the sea brought us a bottle that says hello
episodes.beat: Last Harbor is three: Old Morten, Bram and the cat. The ship gets its first three planks. A bottle washes ashore with one word inside: Hello?

founders.trait: Sees things in the fog. Writes them all down.
Has talked to the ship more than to people.
Belongs to no one. Turns up everywhere.

a wooden chair, just a chair, bone dry, as if nobody ever sat in it
